A.text: Use stored Pass A if valid, else KEEP_PLUMBING.

B.text: Use stored Pass B if valid, else KEEP_PLUMBING.

C.text: Use stored Pass C if valid, else KEEP_PLUMBING.

J_only.text: Use stored adjudicator J if the cell was adjudicated and J is a valid candidate; otherwise KEEP_PLUMBING.

majority_original.text: Among present A/B/C votes (KEEP counts as a vote; missing is abstention), accept an identifier with at least two votes; otherwise KEEP_PLUMBING.

official_original.text: If the cell was originally adjudicated, use valid J else KEEP. Otherwise use majority_original.

A_backbone.text: Use A exactly (valid candidate or KEEP). Invalid A becomes KEEP.

A_fill_BC.text: If A is a candidate, use A. Else if B == C and that value is a non-KEEP candidate, use B. Else KEEP.

A_fill_J.text: If A is a candidate, use A. Else if J is a candidate, use J. Else KEEP.

A_fill_BC_then_J.text: If A is a candidate, use A. Else if B == C and non-KEEP candidate, use B. Else if J is a candidate, use J. Else KEEP.

A_replace_BC.text: If B == C and non-KEEP candidate, use B. Else use A (or KEEP if A invalid).

A_replace_J.text: If J is a candidate, use J. Else use A.

A_replace_BC_then_J.text: If B == C and non-KEEP candidate, use B. Else if J is a candidate, use J. Else use A.

A_veto_double_keep.text: If B == KEEP and C == KEEP, KEEP. Else use A.

nonkeep_plurality.text: Ignore KEEP votes. If a candidate has at least two of the remaining votes, use it. Else KEEP.

nonkeep_plurality_A_tiebreak.text: Ignore KEEP votes. Choose the unique candidate with strictly most votes. On a candidate tie, use A if A is among the tied candidates. Else KEEP.

any_two_then_A.text: If any candidate (KEEP ignored) has two votes, use it. Else use A.

J_on_three_way_only.text: If a candidate has two A/B/C votes, use it. Else if A, B, and C are three distinct present outcomes and J is a candidate, use J. Else use A.

prio_A_J_C_B.text: First non-KEEP valid candidate in order A, J, C, B, else KEEP.

prio_A_C_B_J.text: First non-KEEP valid candidate in order A, C, B, J, else KEEP.

prio_J_A_C_B.text: First non-KEEP valid candidate in order J, A, C, B, else KEEP.

prio_C_A_B_J.text: First non-KEEP valid candidate in order C, A, B, J, else KEEP.

unanimous_candidate_else_A.text: If A, B, and C are the same non-KEEP candidate, use it. Else use A.

unanimous_or_two_candidate_else_A.text: If a non-KEEP candidate has two or three A/B/C votes, use it. Else use A.

A_only_when_another_pass_agrees.text: If A is a candidate and A equals B or A equals C, use A. Else KEEP.

A_or_J_only_when_supported_by_another_pa.text: If A is a candidate and A equals B, C, or J, use A. Else if J is a candidate and J equals B or C, use J. Else KEEP.

cost_policy.A_plus_B: Pass A + Pass B, because B is generated only after A
cost_policy.any_J: Pass A + B + C + adjudication, because J exists only after all three passes
cost_policy.salvage: no extra tokens; derived from stored raw
